[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Zast''' was a free-born [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chev]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A member of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]], he was assigned to the [[Nishr Taskforce]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. Zast served as the aide to the unit commander, [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Fisk Csino]], as well as assisting in mission planning and coordinating the base operations of the company's headquarters, [[Nishr Base Seven]].<ref name="ROE" />
